newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Former Tunisian finance minister to head UTB bank.
newsitem.headline: Former Tunisian finance minister to head UTB bank.

text.p: Former Tunisian Finance Minister Nouri Zorgati has been named successor to Ferid ben Tanfous as chairman of Paris-based Union Tunisienne de Banques (UTB), banking sources said on Friday.
Ben Tanfous, 44, has been appointed chairman of Banque de Developpement Economique de Tunisie, Tunis, which owns 6.21 percent of UTB.

Zorgati, 59, was finance minister from 1987 to 1989 and from 1992 to January 1997. He supervised liberalisation of Tunisia's financial sector and introduced fiscal reforms. He has already headed UTB once for a short period in 1991.

Other UTB shareholders include the Tunisian Central Bank (BCT) with 33.32 percent stake, Banque Nationale Agricole and Societe Tunisienne de Banques 18.8 percent each, airline Tunis Air 7.26 percent, and Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement 7.02 percent.
The bank has five branches in France and one offshore office in Tunis.
